items.label: Bow
identityEvidence: Official Pokémon GO Halloween Part I 2026 announcement lists Sinistea wearing a bow (Shiny-capable): https://pokemongo.com/news/halloween-part-1-2026
Leek Duck lists pm854.fP_HALLOWEEN_2026_01.icon.png with alt "Sinistea wearing a bow" and an article render sinistea-bow.png: https://leekduck.com/events/halloween-2026-part-1/
Prefix P_ is the Phony form; the same page does not list an Antique-form bow icon

review.notes: Viewed: teal Phony-form Sinistea teacup with a purple striped bow and brooch. Exact identity, clean render. Not approved: third-party hosted copy of Niantic art.
Viewed: same costume but only 63x48 px, visibly pixelated. Too small to display.

blockedBy: pm854.fP_HALLOWEEN_2026_01 is not in the PokeMiners snapshot (commit db10df7, 2026-10-28; Sinistea has only fPHONY/fANTIQUE) and not in the game master form table yet; pokeminers.com/scratch is a Google Drive folder that cannot be listed from here
Only third-party hosted copies exist: owner approval needed before any is shown
Antique-form bow art not found (see sinistea-bow-antique)
items.nextStep: Re-run scripts/artwork-candidates.mjs once PokeMiners lands the file; the identity above then resolves through /api/art automatically after a visual check.
